checklist.promise: Start Timer: User runs the program (optionally with flags).
checklist.evidence: code shows flag parsing in cli_logic.go

checklist.promise: Monitor Progress: User watches the terminal as the time remaining decrements and the session number increments.
Session Transition: When a session ends, a terminal bell sounds, and the next session type begins automatically.
checklist.evidence: 3s run is insufficient to reach the 25m transition

checklist.promise: Interrupt Timer: User presses Ctrl-C. The program catches SIGINT, stops the timer, and prints the total number of completed focus sessions.
checklist.evidence: stdout shows completion message upon SIGINT

checklist.promise: Invalid Configuration: User provides invalid... session lengths... The program should error out and exit before starting.
